messages.author: a727896978a01a16
messages.subject: Deploying to shinyapps.io: Error building image: Error building jqr (1.0.0)
parts:
Hi,

Has anyone encountered the following on attempting to publish from RStudio to shinyapps.io.

I'd be grateful for any suggestions on how to resolve.

Thanks


[2017-10-23T10:30:23.281264223+0000] Building R package: jqr (1.0.0)
/mnt/packages/build /mnt
* installing to library ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
* installing *source* package ‘jqr’ ...
** package ‘jqr’ successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
Using PKG_CFLAGS=
Using PKG_LIBS=-ljq
------------------------- ANTICONF ERROR ---------------------------
Configuration failed because libjq was not found.
On Ubuntu 14.04 or 16.04 you can use the PPA:
  sudo add-apt-repository -y ppa:opencpu/jq
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get install libjq-dev
On other sytems try installing:
 * deb: libjq-dev (Debian, Ubuntu 16.10 and up).
 * rpm: jq-devel (Fedora, EPEL)
 * csw: libjq_dev (Solaris)
 * brew: jq (OSX)
If  is already installed set INCLUDE_DIR and LIB_DIR manually via:
R CMD INSTALL --configure-vars='INCLUDE_DIR=... LIB_DIR=...'
--------------------------------------------------------------------
ERROR: configuration failed for package ‘jqr’
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/jqr’
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 492800387 failed: Error building image: Error building jqr (1.0.0). Build exited with non-zero status: 1
Execution halted
